metadata.coverage: Audited union of identified direct questions, selected policy-relevant elections/recalls, state-control changes and selected bills. Not a certified exhaustive national election census.
counting_rules: Every record retains its scope, source quality and date. This is an audited research inventory, not a certified exhaustive registry of all local elections nationwide.
Count questions, elections and elected offices separately. Multiple questions in one town do not represent distinct groups of voters.
Use yes/(yes+no) for ordinary question shares; keep blank/overvote counts and charter thresholds separately. Do not infer turnout from valid votes alone.
Candidate victories cannot isolate a data-center issue's causal effect. Advisory votes are public opinions with no automatic legal ban.
Current officeholders and incoming elected officials are different time states; November wins do not retroactively enact proposals.

base_census.method: One row per question. Preserve yes/no polarity, advisory status, event dates, source update dates, missing data and conflicts. Most Nov3 returns remain unofficial at cutoff. Primary_counts_verified means counts read in primary text or visually checked against a downloaded official return, not certification. Restriction_outcome describes the direction of the successful ballot choice; for advisory votes this does not mean a legal restriction was enacted.
